page_collections.index_types_description: Select the AI capabilities you need. ApeRAG will build the corresponding indexes when documents are uploaded.

index_type_VECTOR.title: Vector
index_type_VECTOR.description: Represents data (text, images, etc.) as high-dimensional vectors to enable similarity-based retrieval.

index_type_FULLTEXT.title: Fulltext
index_type_FULLTEXT.description: Indexes keywords within text using techniques like inverted indexing for exact or fuzzy search.

index_type_GRAPH.title: Graph
index_type_GRAPH.description: Stores data as entities and relationships, enabling graph exploration and relational retrieval.

index_type_SUMMARY.title: Summary
index_type_SUMMARY.description: Indexes summaries or metadata of long documents instead of raw content for faster review.

index_type_VISION.title: Vision
index_type_VISION.description: Encodes visual content (images/videos) into feature vectors for content-based retrieval.

page_collections.model_settings_description: Select AI models for document processing. Different index types require different model support.
page_collections.embedding_model_description: An embedding model translates data into numerical vectors that capture their semantic meaning and relationships.
page_collections.embedding_model_locked_description: The embedding model cannot be changed after the collection is created, because different embedding models produce incompatible vectors. Create a new collection if you need a different model.
page_collections.completion_model_description: A completion model is an AI that generates new content by predicting the most likely subsequent text based on a given input.

hero.title: Turn enterprise knowledge into
hero.description: ApeRAG combines hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, and observable agent execution so operators can ask operational questions without losing provenance.

hero_trace.prompt: SMT-03 on line 3 reported E-047 this morning. Help me narrow down the likely cause.
hero_trace.title: Agent trace

question.label: Understand
question.text: Clarifies the equipment, error code, and time window before touching tools.

graph.label: Graph
graph.text: Searches the knowledge graph for SMT-03 and related failure events.

manual.label: Documents
manual.text: Reads maintenance notes and the E-047 troubleshooting section.

compare.label: Compare
compare.text: Matches the recent incidents with historical feeder tension symptoms.

answer.label: Answer
answer.text: Returns a concise diagnosis with citations and the next inspection steps.

hybrid.title: Hybrid retrieval
hybrid.description: Vector, full-text, graph, and document evidence stay available in one query path.

graph.title: Knowledge graph
graph.description: Entities, incidents, documents, and relationships become inspectable instead of hidden in chunks.

agent.title: Observable agents
agent.description: Reasoning steps, searches, readings, and final answers are separated for review.

deployment.title: Production controls
deployment.description: Authentication, model providers, quota, API keys, audit logs, and admin controls remain part of the product.

agent.title: The answer is only useful when the path is visible.
agent.description: ApeRAG keeps the agent trace readable by default: what it tried, what it read, what it compared, and which sources support the final answer.

runtime.title: Replayable runtime
runtime.description: Streaming events are preserved as a clear action timeline rather than raw tool payloads.

mcp.title: MCP-ready tools
mcp.description: Internal systems can be exposed as controlled tools without changing the user-facing conversation model.

audit.title: Reviewable execution
audit.description: Citations, feedback, and trace details stay available without cluttering the primary reading path.

graph.title: Dense relationships, rendered with restraint.
graph.description: The graph view keeps entity types, neighbors, search, and merge suggestions available while using a quieter warm palette for daily work.

deployment.title: Built for controlled enterprise environments.
deployment.description: The design upgrade does not remove operational surfaces. Existing configuration, document management, quota, providers, and admin paths continue under the same visual system.

private.title: Private runtime
private.description: Deploy ApeRAG in your own environment and keep data controls explicit.

models.title: Model platform
models.description: Provider and model configuration remains first-class, not hidden behind a demo shell.

management.title: Admin surfaces
management.description: API keys, quota, audit logs, and system configuration will use the same brand layer.

cta.title: Open a collection, ask a question, inspect the path.
cta.description: The new interface focuses on the workflows ApeRAG already supports: collections, documents, graph visualization, agent chat, marketplace publishing, and operational controls.
